The fourth group typically includes cations like Co²⁺, Ni²⁺, Mn²⁺, Zn²⁺, and Fe²⁺, which form sulfides that are insoluble in water but soluble in acidic solutions.

From the previous subtasks, we have identified the presence of Cu²⁺, Hg²⁺, and Pb²⁺ in the second analytical group. These cations are not part of the fourth group. The third group analysis returned "None," indicating no cations from that group.
